raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

  Fixes #37369.

  With `--load-format runai_streamer`, `Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.load_weights` stores whichever of `q_a_proj` / `kv_a_proj_with_mqa` arrives first in `cached_a_proj`, then concatenates the two into `fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa` once the second one arrives. The RunAI streamer yields views into a staging buffer that it reuses for later tensors,
  so the cached projection can be overwritten before the fusion happens. The result is a corrupted fused MLA weight and garbage output.

  The DeepSeek loader already copies streamed tensors it holds onto, using `_clone_if_runai_streamed_tensor`. The GLM-5 Next loader did not. The same path also loads the DFLASH draft model.

  This is a minimal version of #37370 (closed without merging). Instead of adding a new module, it reuses the existing helper.

  ## Modifications

  - `python/sglang/srt/models/glm5_next.py`: store `_clone_if_runai_streamed_tensor(loaded_weight)` in `cached_a_proj`. Tensors that the RunAI streamer did not mark are stored as before, without a copy.
  - `test/registered/unit/models/test_glm5_next_runai_ownership.py`: a CPU-only regression test. It streams `q_a_proj` and `kv_a_proj_with_mqa` through one reused, RunAI-marked buffer and checks that `fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa == cat(q_a, kv_a)`. It fails on `main` with `Mismatched elements: 12 / 24 (50.0%)` and passes with this change.

  ## Accuracy Tests

  No change to model forward code. This only fixes which weights get loaded under `runai_streamer`; loading from local files is unchanged.

  ## Speed Tests and Profiling

  The extra copy only happens for RunAI-streamed `q_a_proj` / `kv_a_proj_with_mqa` tensors. Each copy is kept only until its partner arrives, so at most one a-projection per layer is held at a time. Other load formats are unaffected.

  ## Checklist

  - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
  - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).

(N/A, load-path fix only)
  - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

  ## Review and Merge Process

  1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
  2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
  3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.model_loader.weight_utils import RUNAI_STREAMER_TENSOR_ATTR
+from sglang.srt.models import glm5_next
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+PREFIX = "model.layers.0.self_attn"
+
+
+def _stream_through_one_buffer(weights):
+    buffer = torch.empty(max(w.numel() for _, w in weights))
+    for name, weight in weights:
+        view = buffer[: weight.numel()].view_as(weight)
+        view.copy_(weight)
+        setattr(view, RUNAI_STREAMER_TENSOR_ATTR, True)
+        yield name, view
+
+
+class TestGlm5NextRunaiOwnership(CustomTestCase):
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def test_fused_qkv_a_proj_keeps_a_copy_of_the_first_projection(self):
+        q_a = torch.full((3, 4), 1.0)
+        kv_a = torch.full((3, 4), 2.0)
+        fused = nn.Parameter(torch.full((6, 4), torch.nan), requires_grad=False)
+        model = SimpleNamespace(
+            config=SimpleNamespace(n_routed_experts=0),
+            num_fused_shared_experts=0,
+            quant_config=None,
+            fuse_qkv_a_proj=True,
+            named_parameters=lambda: iter(
+                [(f"{PREFIX}.fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight", fused)]
+            ),
+        )
+
+        with patch.object(glm5_next.DeepseekV2WeightLoaderMixin, "post_load_weights"):
+            glm5_next.Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.load_weights(
+                model,
+                _stream_through_one_buffer(
+                    [
+                        (f"{PREFIX}.q_a_proj.weight", q_a),
+                        (f"{PREFIX}.kv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight", kv_a),
+                    ]
+                ),
+            )
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(fused.data, torch.cat([q_a, kv_a]))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
